protocol.decision_index: zero at reset; one-based executed decisions
protocol.probabilities: Original model action probabilities before epsilon exploration; not hit probabilities
protocol.image_sampling: Every available physical-tick RGB image; every state retained
protocol.image_fallback: Hold the preceding real RGB image when native state is unavailable; image_tick identifies it
protocol.terminal_playback: Freeze each system at its actual terminal transition while the shared clock continues
protocol.success: Positive observed kill-count delta before the task deadline

selection.rule: Three outcome-selected Basic test illustrations in which the current unified NanoJev succeeds and both comparison policies fail. The examples cover a far-right target, a far-left target and a smaller rightward correction. They are selected illustrations, not an estimate of aggregate performance. All 128 test and 128 OOD episodes are reported separately.
selection.aggregate_scope: All 128 frozen Basic test cases; all 128 OOD cases reported separately
